6 تبادّوا They removed to a distance, one from another. (Ham p. 823.) ―
-b2- They went, or passed, two by two, each one of a pair removing, or withdrawing, with the other, or making the other to retire, or withdraw, far away. (M.) ―
-b3- They went forth into the field [of battle], one to another: (A:) or they took their adversaries, or opponents, [with whom to fight,] (T, S, K,) each man his man; as also ↓ لَقُوا بَدَادَهُمْ : (K:) or this latter signifies they met their numbers, to each man a man. (T, S.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
